summary: The V5 run succeeded structurally (correct markers, functional module names, Mermaid graph, all 14 DETAIL files produced) but failed on content completeness: 213 of 319 file blocks are missing 数据流 (Data Flow) sections, affecting 9 of 14 modules. The failure is systematic — all four testing-* modules have zero data flow sections, indicating sub-agents consistently deprioritized this section for test files. The Skill instructions are unambiguous ('NEVER skip this'), but lack an enforcement mechanism (automated count-and-fix step). The root cause is agent_error: Step 4 validation was not executed. The secondary failure (S5: coverage 11.2% in state.json) is caused by incomplete source_files_covered arrays in submit_analysis calls — also agent_error with a clear Skill fix. Priority fix: convert Step 4 from a prose instruction to a tool-based gate using Grep counts before allowing index-fragment write.
